hook: Too big for phone or MacBook Air memory; fits a gaming PC
items: Flagship phone: No, Q2_0 needs 37.6 GB
Laptop, 8 GB, no GPU: No, Strata lists only GPUs and Apple Silicon
MacBook Air, 16 GB: SSD only, much slower, untested below 32 GB
RTX 4060, 8 GB: Yes, Q2_0, 37.6 GB, with 48 GB RAM
RTX 4090, 24 GB: Yes, IQ3_S, 54.8 GB, with 64 GB RAM
AIME25 96.67: Competition maths at 2.4 bits per weight; full model scores 100
GPQA-Diamond 89.39: Graduate-level science questions, 2.5 below the full model's 91.92
Task average 89.07: Q2_0 ties IQ2_XS (0.1 apart) and trails IQ3_XXS by 3.5
the_catch: ISTA-DASLab ran these tests itself, and Strata calls its memory figures estimates: a given context may still not fit.
figure_sources: Flagship phone: https://huggingface.co/ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF (Q2_0 shard 1, 37.6 GB; compared by arithmetic with the machine's memory)
Laptop, 8 GB, no GPU: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Niko1221/Strata/main/docs/INSTALL.md ("What you need" lists only NVIDIA RTX, AMD Radeon, Intel Arc, Apple Silicon, Strix Halo and DGX Spark)

MacBook Air, 16 GB: https://huggingface.co/ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF (Q2_0 shard 1, 37.6 GB; compared by arithmetic with 16 GB); https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Niko1221/Strata/main/docs/MAC.md (SSD streaming measured on Macs from 32 GB; below that, untested)

RTX 4060, 8 GB: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Niko1221/Strata/main/docs/MODELS.md ("With 48 GB, Q2_0 and IQ2_XS fit"; Q2_0 37.6 GB from https://huggingface.co/ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF, which says Strata runs it from 8 GB of VRAM)

RTX 4090, 24 GB: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Niko1221/Strata/main/docs/MODELS.md ("With 64 GB of RAM every size fits"; IQ3_S 54.8 GB from https://huggingface.co/ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF)
caption: Can you run a big open model at home? The memory needed for the 2-bit and 3-bit versions of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is 37.6 GB to 54.8 GB, which does not fit in the memory of a phone and a MacBook Air with 16 GB, and fits a gaming PC with enough RAM. Save this for your next download. What do you run models on?
alt_text: A cheat sheet on whether Qwen3.8-Flash-Next runs on five machines, from a phone to an RTX 4090, with three benchmark scores explained in plain words and the catch.

es.hook: Demasiado grande para la memoria de un teléfono o de un MacBook Air; cabe en una PC para juegos
items: Teléfono insignia: No, Q2_0 necesita 37,6 GB
Portátil, 8 GB, sin GPU: No, Strata solo enumera GPUs y Apple Silicon
MacBook Air, 16 GB: Solo SSD, mucho más lento, no probado por debajo de 32 GB
RTX 4060, 8 GB: Sí, Q2_0, 37,6 GB, con 48 GB de RAM
RTX 4090, 24 GB: Sí, IQ3_S, 54,8 GB, con 64 GB de RAM
AIME25 96,67: Matemáticas de competición a 2,4 bits por peso; el modelo completo alcanza 100
GPQA-Diamond 89,39: Preguntas de ciencia a nivel de posgrado, 2,5 por debajo de los 91,92 del modelo completo
Promedio de tareas 89,07: Q2_0 empata con IQ2_XS (a 0,1 de diferencia) y queda 3,5 puntos por detrás de IQ3_XXS
es.the_catch: ISTA‑DASLab realizó estas pruebas por sí mismo, y Strata indica que sus cifras de memoria son estimaciones: un contexto dado aún podría no caber.
